newsitem.title: USA: NCS Healthcare Inc acquires Long Term.
newsitem.headline: NCS Healthcare Inc acquires Long Term.

text.p: NCS HealthCare Inc said on Thursday it acquired Long Term Care, a company with annual revenues of approximately $5 million.
Long Term Care, located in East Greenwich, Rhode Island, provides institutional pharmacy and related services and serves 2,200 residents of long-term care facilities in Rhode Island.
NCS HealthCare Inc is an independent provider of pharmacy and related services to long-term care institutions, including skilled nursing centers and assisted living facilities.
